reasoning: Round 2 keeps the round-1 primary-document build and fixes what the supervisor established: (1) the DOJ/40-state False Claims Act settlement is final ($348.7M + $35.5M, CA AG 2026-09-21) -> p=1, -$345M after tax; (2) the 2026-08-20 8-K says ~12,700 infants remain AFTER the deal (round 1 subtracted 2,000 wrongly) -> NEC remaining -$875M; (3) the 2026-10-21 Nutrition separation (8-K: tax-free, by end-2027) -> -$320M one-time cash and a 10% ladder branch where the distribution precedes 2027-10-20 and the quote falls ~$10 (Abbott's AbbVie spin, announced Oct-2011, completed 2013-01-01, finished at the end of its target year); (4) CMS CGM competitive bidding (awards 2027) priced into FY28 Diabetes growth and the multiple; (5) P/E re-based on the 11-peer median 18.8x ex-ISRG, set at 17.5x (supervisor 17.0x: I keep a smaller discount because ABT's ~9.3% EPS growth equals the peer median and the spin removes the lowest-multiple segment); (6) SOTP weight cut to 0.20 (kept, not zero, because the spin makes the parts' separate pricing concrete). From the call transcript: diabetes low-to-mid single digit for several quarters (Diabetes FY27/28 5.0/5.5% vs 7.5/7.5%), EP ~20% in Q4 (Other MD FY27 7.0%), Cancer Dx already at a high-teens margin (17/19% vs 14/17%), 2027 sales growth 'pretty similar' (~5.9% pro forma organic in the build). EPS FY27 $5.99 / FY28 $6.55 (consensus $6.08/$6.74, -1.5%/-2.8%). Fair value $110.82 (from $116.93), +13% vs ~$98.4. Ladder: 60% scenario mix (bear $79 / base $111 / bull $133, 25/55/20, within-scenario sigma 0.16) + 40% lognormal around ~$102 (start $98.4 plus drift, sigma 0.27), then 10% spin branch scaled by 0.91: median ~$102.5, P(>= $102) ~0.51, P(>= $138) ~0.11, P(< $82) ~0.21. No option data used; research limited to ~8 follow-ups.

model_inputs.structure_note: Value is carried by three multiple legs on the 6-segment driver build (pro forma FY2025 base incl. Exact Sciences' $3,247M 2025 sales; FY2026 Cancer Dx -8.2% is the ownership stub, not a decline): P/E 17.5x on NTM adjusted EPS at the horizon (weight 0.55), EV/EBITDA 13.5x NTM (0.25) and an EV-level sum of the parts with a multiple per segment (0.20). Weights are judgment, untested: forward P/E leads (Liu, Nissim & Thomas; supervisor), and the SOTP keeps a reduced 0.20 (from 0.35) because the 2026-10-21 Nutrition separation (src 14) means the market will price Nutrition and the rest of Abbott separately around the horizon. No DCF leg. ebit_basis 'adjusted' = Abbott's adjusted operating earnings (excl. amortization and specified items, AFTER stock comp, which Abbott does not add back), so sbc_pct_rev is 0 and SBC is costed once. corporate_ebit (unallocated cost net of non-operating income) is calibrated so engine EPS reconciles to the FY26 guide at full-year deal interest: FY26 ~$5.43, FY27 ~$5.99 (consensus $6.08, -1.5%), FY28 ~$6.55 (consensus $6.74, -2.8%). The Nutrition spin is modelled as value-neutral to holders and enters only the ladder as a branch (quote drops by NutritionCo equity if it completes before 2027-10-20); separation costs are an adjustment.
model_inputs.gap_note: Judgment calls for review: (1) 17.5x horizon P/E vs the 11-peer median 18.8x and ~16.5x today: each 1x ~ $6.4/share on the P/E leg (~$3.5 on the blend); (2) SOTP weight 0.20 kept on the spin argument (supervisor would make it a cross-check: moving it to 0 and P/E to 0.75 gives ~$111, so immaterial); (3) NEC remaining exposure is an estimate (~$40k/infant + 20% x $2.5B tail), $75M below the supervisor's -$950M; (4) Cancer Dx margins (17%/19%) lean on the CFO/CEO 'high teens' exit-rate statement; (5) net debt is the 6/30 10-Q figure (Q3 10-Q not yet filed); NEC and DOJ cash paid after 6/30 enter as adjustments; (6) operating leases left out of net debt, as in peer EVs; (7) the spin's NutritionCo debt and stranded costs are not yet quantified by the company.
